title: Branching Scenario Spec (engine #1)
description: Declarative spec for the branching scenario engine (engine #1, ledger §E / F5). A scenario graph of nodes (situation/prompt) connected by choice edges that carry consequence text and a score delta; safety-relevant wrong branches set safety_flag/is_safety_decision so the shared safety-veto hook can veto a pass (ledger §B). Terminal nodes are pass/fail outcomes. Supports the 'failure is safe, instant, instructive' rule and the egress post-mortem replay (freeze at the trap, overlay the deciding choice + the code line, drop back to the decision — F5 §7). engine_kind is pinned to 'branching_scenario' (academy.sim_kind).

$schema.description: Optional editor/CI hint pointing at this schema's $id.

envelope.description: The shared sim envelope (identity, competencies, i18n keys, scoring+safety-veto hook, telemetry surface, colorblind-safe states). engine_kind MUST be 'branching_scenario'.

start.description: id of the node the scenario opens on. MUST be a key in `nodes`.

nodes.description: The scenario graph keyed by node id. Each node is either a situation/prompt (with choices) or a terminal outcome.

mediaRef.title: media reference
mediaRef.description: An R2 key (image/video/audio) plus alt text i18n key. Never an inline URL to live content.

verdictMapping.title: verdict rubric mapping
verdictMapping.description: Maps a choice to a §5.4 rubric dimension + line item, so the shared Verdict service scores branching identically to the field rubric. line_item_key mirrors academy.signoff_line_items.line_item_key (e.g. 'ac.203.maglock_failsafe_verified').

edge.title: choice edge
edge.description: A choice the learner can make at a prompt node: it leads to a next node, carries consequence text (instant, specific, diagnostic), a score delta, and — when wrong in a way that endangers life safety — a safety_flag that routes through the veto hook.

id.description: Unique choice id within the node (used in telemetry result.response).

label_i18n.description: The choice text the learner sees.

to.description: id of the next node. MUST be a key in `nodes`.

consequence_i18n.description: What happens / why — shown immediately after the choice. Names the real-world consequence and (for wrong choices) the fix.

score_delta.description: Points added (correct) or subtracted (wrong) when this edge is taken. Aggregated by the Verdict service against the envelope scoring thresholds.

safety_flag.description: True if taking this edge is a SAFETY-CRITICAL wrong decision (e.g. choosing a non-releasing lock on an egress door). Routes through the shared safety-veto hook → forces fail + sim_attempts.safety_veto_triggered, non-overridable (ledger §B). The DB-side mirror is a safety line scoring 0.

is_safety_decision.description: True if this choice POINT is one where a safety-critical judgment is being made (whether or not THIS edge is the wrong one). Lets the engine mark the decision as safety-graded and apply the >=90% bar (ledger §C) to the safety subset.

verdict.description: Optional rubric mapping for this choice (feeds the §5.4-aligned Verdict).

allOf.$comment: A safety_flag edge must explain the consequence and be marked as a safety decision so the veto wording + >=90% bar engage.

node.title: scenario node
node.description: A node is `prompt` (a situation with choices/edges) or `terminal` (a pass/fail outcome). Discriminated by `type`.

oneOf.title: prompt node
oneOf.description: A situation + the decision the learner must make. Carries the prompt text, optional media, and the choice edges.

is_safety_decision.description: True if this node is a safety-critical decision point (drives the >=90% safety subset and post-mortem replay anchoring).

choices.description: The edges out of this node. At least two; exactly the learner's options.

oneOf.title: terminal node
oneOf.description: A scenario ending. `outcome` is the verdict; a fail caused by a safety_flag edge sets safety_veto=true. Supports the egress post-mortem replay: when replay is present and the outcome is a safety fail, the engine freezes the scene, overlays the deciding choice + the code line, then drops the learner back to the deciding node.

safety_veto.description: True if THIS terminal is reached because a safety_flag edge was taken (the trapped-occupants ending). The engine sets sim_attempts.safety_veto_triggered and uses the envelope veto_state/veto_feedback.

outcome_i18n.description: The ending narration (e.g. 'Everyone evacuated.' / 'Occupants were trapped behind a locked door.').

state.description: Colorblind-safe state token to render for this ending (pass→check, fail→cross, safety fail→octagon).

replay.title: post-mortem replay
replay.description: Egress post-mortem replay (F5 §7): on a safety fail, freeze the scene at the trap, overlay the deciding choice + the cited code line, then return the learner to the deciding node to re-choose.

freeze_node.description: Node id whose scene is frozen as the 'trap' tableau.

decided_at_node.description: Node id the learner is dropped back to (the deciding prompt).

overlay_i18n.description: The deciding-choice + code-line overlay text (e.g. 'NFPA 101 §7.2.1.6.2: a mag lock must release on loss of power.').

allOf.$comment: A safety_veto terminal must be a fail and should carry a replay so failure is instructive.
